short: From surface to bulk modification: Plasma polymerization of
title: From surface to bulk modification: Plasma polymerization of amine-bearing coating by synergic strategy of biomolecule grafting and nitric oxide loading

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Blood-contacting implants need endothelium-like thromboresistance; existing NO-donor coatings are thick, unstable and detach. An amine-rich plasma-polymerised allylamine film can store NO in bulk and anchor an anti-coagulant on its surface for synergistic antithrombogenicity.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n23 (DES/modification), n4 (PRC/deposition), n6 (PRC/synthesis), n10 (DES/down_select), n11 (PRC/deposition), n12 (PRC/synthesis), n13 (PRC/synthesis). Premises: Pulsed-mode plasma polymerisation retains the amine groups of allylamine better than continuous mode [38]; Rapid NO release from PPAm has been ascribed to its hydrophilicity [15,16]

states.title: Structure state
states.head: NO is stored in PPAm as N-diazeniumdiolate (NONOate) groups. BVLD is immobilised on the coating surface at ~0.74 ug/cm2 and stays after PBS rinsing.
states.detail: Absorbed: n8 (STR/chemistry/bonding), n14 (STR/chemistry/composition), n15 (STR/chemistry/bonding). Premises: Diazeniumdiolate IR bands: NO vibration ~1735, N=N ~1600, N-N ~1470, N-O ~1386 cm-1 [18]

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: NO-loaded PPAm releases NO as a burst peaking ~5 min after immersion and falls to near zero within ~1 h. The PPAmF composite reduces the NO burst and prolongs NO release beyond 8 h, versus ~1 h for PPAm.
states.detail: Absorbed: n9 (PRP/value), n16 (PRP/value), n17 (PRP/value), n18 (PRP/value). Premises: Bivalirudin is a synthetic direct thrombin inhibitor whose activity depends on its N- and C-terminal domains [49]

states.title: Performance state
states.head: In an arteriovenous shunt, BVLD/NO-PPAmF nearly prevents occlusive thrombus: ~3% occlusion, ~2 mg thrombus, ~90% of blood flow retained

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Surface BVLD grafting plus bulk NO loading of a plasma-polymerised PPAmF coating is a material-independent route to near-perfect antithrombogenicity

nodes.title: evidence, F1
nodes.head: PPAm IR bands assigned: N-H stretch 3350/3210, C-H stretch, -N=C=O/-C=N 2245/2180, -C=O/C=N 1645, C-N 1230 cm-1. Positive ToF-SIMS spectrum shows labelled N-containing ions CH4N (m/z 30), C3H9N (m/z 59) and C4H10N (m/z 72) among CxHy ions
nodes.note: strongest peaks are hydrocarbon C3H5 (41) and C4H7 (55); negative spectrum (CN-, CNO-) is Supplementary Fig. 1
nodes.detail: o1: PPAm IR bands assigned: N-H stretch 3350/3210, C-H stretch, -N=C=O/-C=N 2245/2180, -C=O/C=N 1645, C-N 1230 cm-1; o2: Positive ToF-SIMS spectrum shows labelled N-containing ions CH4N (m/z 30), C3H9N (m/z 59) and C4H10N (m/z 72) among CxHy ions

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Starred NO vibration, N=N, N-N and N-O stretch bands appear in NO-PPAm and are absent from the PPAm spectrum
nodes.solves: NO is stored in PPAm as N-diazeniumdiolate (NONOate) groups
nodes.note: N-N (~1480) and N-O (~1390) peaks are the strongest features of the NO-PPAm trace
nodes.detail: o3: Starred NO vibration, N=N, N-N and N-O stretch bands appear in NO-PPAm and are absent from the PPAm spectrum
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o1, o2 after removal.

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: BVLD-PPAmF spectrum carries a labelled -COOH stretch (~3400 cm-1) and -C=O band (~1660 cm-1) over the PPAmF spectrum. QCM-D: BVLD mass rises after BVLD injection to ~0.78 ug/cm2 and settles near 0.71 after PBS rinse; 0.74 +/- 0.05 ug/cm2 annotated
nodes.solves: BVLD is immobilised on the coating surface at ~0.74 ug/cm2 and stays after PBS rinsing
nodes.op: compare across conditions, read characteristic point
nodes.note: PPAmF (black) also has a band near 1650 cm-1; the -COOH hump is weak; text writes the units as cm-2
nodes.detail: o5: BVLD-PPAmF spectrum carries a labelled -COOH stretch (~3400 cm-1) and -C=O band (~1660 cm-1) over the PPAmF spectrum; o7: QCM-D: BVLD mass rises after BVLD injection to ~0.78 ug/cm2 and settles near 0.71 after PBS rinse; 0.74 +/- 0.05 ug/cm2 annotated
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n14 (o7).

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: Starred NONOate bands (NO vibration, N=N, N-N, N-O) appear in NO-PPAmF and BVLD/NO-PPAmF, not in PPAmF
nodes.solves: NO is stored as diazeniumdiolate groups in NO-PPAmF and BVLD/NO-PPAmF coatings
nodes.note: NONOate bands are small shoulders compared with F2a; a strong H-bonded -OH band also appears in the NO-loaded traces (moved from label; no claim uses it)
nodes.detail: o6: Starred NONOate bands (NO vibration, N=N, N-N, N-O) appear in NO-PPAmF and BVLD/NO-PPAmF, not in PPAmF

nodes.title: MICRO, F5
nodes.head: Many spread, dendritic platelets on 316L SS and PPAmF; fewer on BVLD-PPAmF and NO-PPAmF; a few round, unspread platelets on BVLD/NO-PPAmF
nodes.solves: BVLD/NO-PPAmF suppresses platelet adhesion and activation more than BVLD-PPAmF or NO-PPAmF alone
nodes.note: caption says 2 h in PRP, linked text says 30 min
nodes.necessity_reason: n18 keeps shown support from o12, o13 after removal.

nodes.head: NO-PPAm NO flux peaks at ~35e-10 mol cm-2 min-1 about 5 min in and decays to ~0 by 60 min
nodes.solves: NO-loaded PPAm releases NO as a burst peaking ~5 min after immersion and falls to near zero within ~1 h

nodes.title: evidence, F2, F3
nodes.head: BVLD/NO-PPAmF NO flux spikes to ~10.5e-10 mol cm-2 min-1, then decays slowly and is still ~0.2-0.3e-10 at 10 h. Across F2b and F3d (same flux units), peak NO flux falls from ~35e-10 (NO-PPAm) to ~10.5e-10 (BVLD/NO-PPAmF) and release extends from ~1 h to >10 h.
nodes.solves: The PPAmF composite reduces the NO burst and prolongs NO release beyond 8 h, versus ~1 h for PPAm
nodes.op: compare across conditions, read characteristic point, replot derived series
nodes.note: broken y axis between ~4 and ~5 cross-figure; the two coatings differ in both C-F interlayers and BVLD grafting spectra are offset and may be scaled differently; the text never comments on it
nodes.detail: o8: BVLD/NO-PPAmF NO flux spikes to ~10.5e-10 mol cm-2 min-1, then decays slowly and is still ~0.2-0.3e-10 at 10 h; o9: Across F2b and F3d (same flux units), peak NO flux falls from ~35e-10 (NO-PPAm) to ~10.5e-10 (BVLD/NO-PPAmF) and release extends from ~1 h to >10 h; a1: The strong C-F band (~1250 cm-1) of PPAmF and BVLD-PPAmF is barely visible in the NO-PPAmF and BVLD/NO-PPAmF spectra

nodes.solves: Grafted BVLD keeps its anti-thrombin bioactivity: thrombin specific activity is roughly halved on BVLD-bearing coatings

nodes.title: evidence, F5
nodes.head: Adhered platelets ~32, 41, 15.5, 11 and 5 (x1e2 cell/mm2) on 316L SS, PPAmF, BVLD-PPAmF, NO-PPAmF, BVLD/NO-PPAmF. Platelet activation ~65, 74, 23, 18 and ~1% across the same five surfaces
nodes.solves: BVLD/NO-PPAmF suppresses platelet adhesion and activation more than BVLD-PPAmF or NO-PPAmF alone
nodes.note: text fold values (2.1 vs BVLD, 1.2 vs NO) match (ratio - 1) of the bars (~3.1, ~2.2)

nodes.solves: In an arteriovenous shunt, BVLD/NO-PPAmF nearly prevents occlusive thrombus: ~3% occlusion, ~2 mg thrombus, ~90% of blood flow retained
